pwa_notes: The package includes PWA files but does not publish them to Netlify automatically.
PWA installation depends on HTTPS, browser support, browser installability checks, and the deployed manifest/service worker being accessible.
iOS uses Add to Home Screen from Safari; Android Chrome/Edge should offer Install app when installable.
An installed PWA remains web technology; it is not an Android APK or native iOS app.
limitations: Live API calls could not be reached from the build environment, so remote tafsir providers were not live-tested here.
The resulting ZIP must be uploaded to the root of the Netlify site and redeployed before phone testing.
